elements.requirement: Licences under Part III of the Road Traffic Act 1988 to drive motor vehicles of classes that include large goods vehicles or passenger-carrying vehicles, or large goods vehicles or passenger-carrying vehicles of any class, must be granted by the Secretary of State in accordance with this Part of the Act.
elements.quote: shall be granted by the Secretary of State in accordance with this Part of this Act

elements.requirement: Licences under Part III of the Road Traffic Act 1988, to the extent that they authorise the driving of large goods vehicles or passenger-carrying vehicles, must otherwise be subject to this Part of the Act in addition to Part III of the Act.
elements.quote: shall, in so far as they authorise the driving of large goods vehicles or passenger-carrying vehicles, be otherwise subject to this Part of this Act in addition to Part III of this Act

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Road Traffic Act 1988, the term 'Community licence' bears the same meaning as it has in Part III of the Act.
elements.quote: “Community licence” has the same meaning as in Part III of this Act

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Road Traffic Act 1988, 'LGV Community licence' means a Community licence to the extent that it authorises an individual to drive large goods vehicles of any class.
elements.quote: “LGV Community licence” means a Community licence in so far as it authorises a person to drive large goods vehicles of any class

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Road Traffic Act 1988, 'PCV Community licence' means a Community licence to the extent that it authorises an individual to drive passenger-carrying vehicles of any class.
elements.quote: “PCV Community licence” means a Community licence in so far as it authorises a person to drive passenger-carrying vehicles of any class

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Road Traffic Act 1988, 'large goods vehicle driver’s licence' means a licence under Part III of the Act to the extent that it authorises an individual to drive large goods vehicles of any class.
elements.quote: “large goods vehicle driver’s licence” means a licence under Part III of this Act in so far as it authorises a person to drive large goods vehicles of any class

elements.requirement: In this Part of the Road Traffic Act 1988, 'passenger-carrying vehicle driver’s licence' means a licence under Part III of the Act to the extent that it authorises an individual to drive passenger-carrying vehicles of any class.
